overviewHtml:
Audit Logs Viewer gives you instant visibility into all audit log events recorded by Dynatrace. Filter by time range, event type, user, or entity to pinpoint exactly what changed and when. It combines classic API audit logs with Grail-powered log storage so you always see the full picture — no matter which Dynatrace generation your environment is on.

What you get

  • Unified view of Grail platform audit logs and legacy API audit logs
  • Filter bar for timeframe, user, event type, and category
  • User IDs resolved to names and emails via the IAM service
setupHtml:
Audit Logs Viewer is available as a Dynatrace app to all customers upon request.

  1. Audit Logs Viewer is delivered via a Hub subscription. Email community-apps@dynatrace.com with your account name and tenant ID, as described here.
  2. We'll process your request and send instructions for subscribing to the channel and installing the app.
  3. After installation, open Hub, search for Audit Logs Viewer, and install it.
getStartedHtml:
1. Request the Hub subscription by emailing the community apps team
  2. Install the app from Hub
  3. Open it and filter your audit logs
